name: 150-unplated-hole-land-joins-nothing
why: MountingHole_3.2mm_M3's own pad, verbatim: (pad 1 np_thru_hole circle (size 3.2 3.2) (drill 3.2) (layers *.Cu *.Mask)). The end cap is dead centre on that land, 1.600mm inside its stated edge — the most generous placement there is, and the one that would read as touching under any geometry at all. It still does not touch: an unplated hole is drilled, never plated, so it has no barrel and no copper. The *.Cu on the pad line declares where copper must be kept AWAY, not where copper is.
